W = {"banks":1,"load_balancers":1,"fifo_bytes":5,"pifo_bytes":5,"refill_batch":1,
     "sample_period":1,"borders":[0,10],"policy":{"kind":"wfq","weights":[[0,3]]},

cases = [b'', b'not json', b'{} {}', b'{"runs":[],"runs":[]}', b'{"x":NaN}', b'{"x":1e999}',
         b'\xff', b'{"runs":[{"runs":[]},{"runs":[]}]}', b'null', b'[]', b'"x"', b'5',
         b'{"runs":[{"banks":2}]}', b'{"runs":{}}', b'{"runs":[1]}',
         b'{"runs":[{"banks":2,"banks":3}]}', b'{"runs":[{"a":1,"a":2}]}',
         b'{"runs":[{"banks":2,"load_balancers":1,"fifo_bytes":8,"pifo_bytes":8,"refill_batch":2,'
         b'"sample_period":1,"borders":[0,5],"policy":{"kind":"sff"},"events":[]}]}',
         b'{"runs":[' + b'{"runs":[]}' * 3 + b']}',
         b'{"runs":[{"banks":1,"load_balancers":1,"fifo_bytes":1,"pifo_bytes":1,"refill_batch":1,'
         b'"sample_period":1,"borders":[0,1],"policy":{"kind":"sff"},"events":[["restore",3]]}]}',
         b'{"runs":[{"banks":1,"load_balancers":1,"fifo_bytes":1,"pifo_bytes":1,"refill_batch":1,'
         b'"sample_period":1,"borders":[0,1],"policy":{"kind":"sff"},"events":[["weight",7,3]]}]}',
         b'{"runs":[{"banks":1,"load_balancers":1,"fifo_bytes":1,"pifo_bytes":1,"refill_batch":1,'
         b'"sample_period":1,"borders":[0,1],"policy":{"kind":"nonsense"},"events":[]}]}',
         b'\x00', b'{"runs":[]}\n\n', b'  {"runs":[]}  ', b'{"runs":[]}{"runs":[]}',
         b'{"a": {"b": [1, 2, {"c": Infinity}]}}', b'{"runs":[]}]',
         json.dumps({"runs": [W, W]}).encode(),
         json.dumps({"runs": []}).encode(),
         ]
bad = 0
for i, data in enumerate(cases):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', 'submission/cli.py'], input=data, capture_output=True)
    out = p.stdout.strip()
    try:
        json.loads(out)
        parsed = True
    except Exception:
        parsed = False
    tag = 'INVALID' if out == b'{"error":"invalid"}' else 'RESULT'
    if p.returncode != 0 or not parsed:
        bad += 1
        tag = 'BAD'
        print(i, 'rc', p.returncode, repr(out[:100]), p.stderr[-300:])
    print('%2d %-8s %s' % (i, tag, out[:70]))
print('failures:', bad)
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
